scoreExplanation.description: Clear explanation of why the candidate received this experience score

scoreExplanation.description: Clear explanation of why the candidate received this location score

scoreExplanation.description: Clear explanation of why the candidate received this industry score

score.description: Final overall score from 0 to 100 computed using the scoring weights
